title: Keep CALM and Avoid Harmful Content: Concept Alignment and Latent Manipulation Towards Safer Answers
reasoning: The paper studies and benchmarks LLM safety by aligning latent directions with human-interpretable concepts, including categories like 'Strong Moral Refusal' and 'Legal & Ethical Refusal'. It evaluates model responses to prompts involving ethical and moral violations such as murder, theft, and harassment.
